subject: English
question_text: Read the following text and fill in each gap with a
stimulus: suitable word based on the information of the text.15 = 5 The Maldives enjoys a pleasant weather throughout the year. In 2008, the Maldives was ranked as the best country for beautiful beaches and facilities for recreation. The Maldives is quite notable for being the lowest country in the world. But it is a matter of sorrow that this small country with idylic natural beauty is under threat form rising sea levels due to global warming. Most of the country is just 15 meters above sea level with the highest point of 23 meters. Many surveys and predictions have been made with respect to Maldivies being swept away by the rising water level in the Indian Ocean. During the tsunami of 2004, many of the island's dry parts were flooded by waters surrounding the island. The government of Maldivies has taken initiative to purchase land from nearby countries in case the islands go under water. The government of Maldives held a cabinet meeting underwater in 2009 to highlight the threats of global warming to its low lying islands. That was the first ever cabinet meeting in the world that was arranged underwater. The meeting took place about 5 metre underwater, in a blue-green lagoon on a small island. While underwater the cabinet signed a document calling on all nations to cut their carbon emissions. [Unit-6; Lesson-3] The Maldives is well-known for its being the (a) ⎯ country in the world. (b) ⎯ to global warming, this small country is under threat from rising sea levels. So the government of the Maldives has begun to (c) ⎯ land from nearby countries. In order to (d) ⎯ the threat to global warming to the country a cabinet meeting was (e) ⎯ underwater by the government in 2009. Read the passage and answer the questions 4 and 5. Jerusalem is regarded as a holy city to the Muslims, Christans and Jews, stians. David (Hazrad Dawood), the king of the Israelis captured Jerusalem in about 1000 BC. King Solomon, (Hazrat Sulaiman) his son, extended the city and built the great mosque that stood until 586 BC. When it was destroyed by king Nebuchadnezzar-ll of Babylon, Rome Captured Jerusalem in 63 BC. From 40 to 44 BC the city prospered under it Roman ruler, king Herod. In 66 AD. The Jews revolted against Roman rule. The Roman Emperor Titus, crushed the rebellion 133 years after conquer of Jerusalem by Rome. Then the city was destroyed in 638 AD. It came under the banner of Islam when the then Christian ruler surrendered it to Hazrat Omar (R). The Crusaders took and plundered Jerusalem in 1099, but Salauddin Ayubi won it back after 88 years. The city remained in Muslim hands until it was captured by the British in 1917. The British withdrew after ruling 31 years and then the Jewish state of Israel was illegally established. The Arab states took control of the old city. In June 1967, the entire of Jerusalem was captured by the Jewish state of Israel.
